_about: Hand labels for the 64 NATURAL pairs in candidates.jsonl (real cross-section sentence pairs sampled by scripts/build_pair_candidates.py). Written BEFORE any NLI model scored these pairs. label: contradiction | not_contradiction. category describes why a non-contradiction might LOOK like one. referent: what the two sentences are about -- 'named' if identified by a proper name, acronym or figure in both, 'common' if by an ordinary noun phrase, 'unrelated' if they are about different things.
